step1_figure.description: A master-slave edge-triggered D flip-flop implemented using transmission gates and cross-coupled inverters. The specific netlist provided includes a DC source of 0.9V on the D input, which is designed to simulate the metastability resolution described in Figure 13.17.

metastability_delay.description: Time taken for the flip-flop to resolve to a valid logic level when the input is sampled at a metastable voltage (VDD/2).

equation.explanation: The resolution time depends on the small-signal gain and time constant (tau = Req*C) of the cross-coupled inverters at the switching point.
equation.assumptions: Input is near the exact switching point voltage (Vsp).

sky130_expected.calculation: With D=0.9V and Vsp ~ 0.78V, the input is not perfectly metastable and will resolve quickly. tau = Req * C ~ 400 ohm * 5 fF = 2 ps. Resolution takes a few time constants.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on how close the forced 0.9V is to the actual Vsp of the parameterized inverters.

switching_point_voltage.description: The voltage (Vsp) where the input equals the output of the latch's inverter, representing the metastable point.

equation.explanation: The voltage where the PMOS and NMOS currents are equal in saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Varies with exact W/L sizing and process corners.

propagation_delay.description: Delay through an internal inverter stage.

equation.explanation: RC delay model for a CMOS inverter.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Unloaded delay is extremely small; wiring and fanout will increase it to the 10-50ps range.

input_capacitance.description: Capacitance looking into an input pin (e.g., clock or D).

equation.explanation: Approximation of gate capacitance for an inverter input.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on device dimensions and layout parasitics.

setup_time.description: Minimum time data must be stable before the active clock edge.

equation.explanation: Time required for data to propagate through the input transmission gate and the first inverter to the internal storage node.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of TG and INV delays ~ 10ps + 15ps = 25ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on sizing and internal node capacitance.

hold_time.description: Minimum time data must be held stable after the active clock edge.

equation.explanation: Because of the propagation delay from the D pin to the internal node, the external D signal can change slightly before the clock edge without corrupting the captured data.

sky130_expected.calculation: Expected to be negative or near zero.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Inherent to the delay of the input transmission gate.

clock_to_q_delay.description: Delay from the active clock edge to the Q output changing.

equation.explanation: Delay through the slave stage transmission gate and output inverter.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of TG and INV delays ~ 10ps + 15ps = 25ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance at the Q output.

step3_testbench.description: Measures metastability resolution delay, internal propagation delay, switching point voltage (Vsp), and attempts to measure normal timing metrics (setup, tpcq) by altering the hardcoded DC source to a pulse.
step3_testbench.spice:
* D-FF Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* Define parameters used in the netlist
.param W_xm1=1u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=2u L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=1u L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm3=2u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=1u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm8=2u L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1u L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=2u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=1u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=2u L_xm12=0.15u
.param W_xm13=1u L_xm13=0.15u
.param W_xm14=2u L_xm14=0.15u
.param W_xm15=1u L_xm15=0.15u
.param W_xm16=2u L_xm16=0.15u

* DUT Netlist
xm1 N004 N002 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 N004 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm5 N003 N004 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 N003 N004 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 D clock_b N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
VD D 0 DC 0.9
xm3 N002 clock D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 N002 clock N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm8 N003 clock_b N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 Q N001 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 Q N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
xm11 Q_bar Q 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
xm12 Q_bar Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
xm13 N004 clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm13} l={L_xm13}
xm14 N001 clock_b N004 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm14} l={L_xm14}
xm15 N001 clock_b Q_bar 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm15} l={L_xm15}
xm16 Q_bar clock N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm16} l={L_xm16}

* Clock Stimulus
Vclk clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
Vclk_b clock_b 0 PULSE(1.8 0 2n 50p 50p 2n 4n)

.control
* 1. Metastability and Propagation Delay (using default D=0.9V)
tran 10p 10n uic
meas tran metastability_delay trig v(clock) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=1.62 rise=1
meas tran propagation_delay trig v(N004) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N003) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran q_in integ i(Vclk) from=1.9n to=2.1n
let input_capacitance = -q_in / 1.8
print input_capacitance

* 2. Switching Point Voltage (Vsp)
dc VD 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc switching_point_voltage find v(N002) when v(N002)=v(N004)

* 3. Setup, Hold, Clock-to-Q
* Alter the hardcoded DC source to a pulse to measure normal timing
alter @VD[pulse] = [ 0 1.8 1.8n 10p 10p 4n 8n ]
tran 10p 10n
meas tran clock_to_q_delay trig v(clock) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=1
* Measure delay of the setup path (D to internal node N002)
meas tran setup_path_delay trig v(D) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N002) val=0.9 rise=1

quit
.endc
